Step 3. The subharmonic functional \(\Phi_{01290013}\) on the Frechet space satisfies \(\|\Phi_{01290013}\| \leq C_01290013\) by the subharmonic embedding theorem.

Conclusion. The result follows by combining Steps 1-3 through Laplace approximation and the compactness of the spectral family.
